body: On a machine that has only ever built debug the check fails with `no Novis binary at …` rather than with a number; `cargo build --release -p nvs-cli` once is the fix, and `bench.py`'s header says why the harness refuses to build anything itself. A release binary older than `crates/` still measures — the staleness warning goes to stderr and the check stays green — so a start-up regression can hide behind a binary nobody rebuilt.
